description:
Found by s507d while checking what `-E` enables.  perl 5.40.3:
  perl -E 'say __SUB__ // "undef"'     -> undef
  pcl  -E 'say __SUB__ // "undef"'     -> __SUB__
  printf 'use feature "current_sub";\nprint __SUB__ // "undef", "\n";\nmy $f = sub { __SUB__ }; print ref($f->()), "\n";\n' > sub1.pl
  perl sub1.pl -> undef / CODE;   pcl sub1.pl -> __SUB__ / CODE
Not switch-specific (the file form shows the same).  At file level __SUB__ with the feature on is undef (perlfunc: "outside of a subroutine, __SUB__ returns undef").  The docs for -E do not list __SUB__ among its features until this is fixed.
subject: LOW (found by s507d, on main 50dbd195): `__SUB__` outside any sub is the STRING "__SUB__" under PCL (perl: undef) -- `pcl -E 'say __SUB__ // "undef"'` prints __SUB__; also in a file with `use feature "current_sub"`; inside an anon sub it is right
